# yarvolk.com

Website: https://yarvolk.com
Type: Personal portfolio + blog
Owner: Yaroslav Volkov
Primary focus: WordPress development, e-commerce websites, and business automation solutions.

## Summary
yarvolk.com is a static Astro website that presents services, portfolio projects, blog articles, and contact information.

## Canonical public pages
- https://yarvolk.com/
- https://yarvolk.com/portfolio
- https://yarvolk.com/blog
- https://yarvolk.com/about
- https://yarvolk.com/contact
- https://yarvolk.com/privacy

## Structured discovery
- Sitemap index: https://yarvolk.com/sitemap-index.xml
- Sitemap: https://yarvolk.com/sitemap-0.xml

## Content scope
- Portfolio case studies live under `/portfolio/*`
- Blog posts live under `/blog/*`
- Core pages: Home, About, Contact, Privacy

## Source of truth in this repository
- Site metadata: `src/config/site.config.json`
- Navigation: `src/config/menus.json`
- Page content: `src/content/pages/*.mdx`
- Blog content: `src/content/blog/*.mdx`
- Portfolio content: `src/content/portfolio/*.mdx`

## Tech stack
- Astro
- MDX content collections
- React components (where needed)
- Tailwind CSS tooling

## Notes for LLM consumers
- Prefer canonical URLs listed above.
- Use sitemap URLs for full page discovery.
- This is a statically generated site; content changes are made in source files and then rebuilt.
